title: Energy Vault secures full land ownership for 1GWh Stoney Creek BESS in Australia
summary: Energy Vault has acquired land for its 125MW/1GWh Stoney Creek BESS in New South Wales, advancing renewable energy initiatives in Australia.
body_markdown:
# Energy Vault secures full land ownership for 1GWh Stoney Creek BESS in Australia


Energy Vault | 7 September 2026


Energy Vault has completed the acquisition of the underlying project land for its 125MW/1,000MWh Stoney Creek battery energy storage system (BESS) in northern New South Wales, Australia.
